name: chart-rises
subject: A person in profile beside a big loose screen with three bars. The bars grow taller and the person raises a fist. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: coffee-ripples
subject: A tiny person relaxes on the right side of a big coffee cup, same pose everywhere. Only the ripples and two steam curls move, one smooth loop.

name: page-turn
subject: A person sits on a stack of books reading an open book, body still. One page lifts, stands upright and lands on the other side. One page per loop.

name: gift-give
subject: A person in profile holds a small gift box with a bow in every panel. The arms stretch forward to offer it, with a small smile. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: laces-tie
subject: Only a pair of sneakers on the ground, no person. The loose laces cross, loop and tie into a neat bow. Panels 1 to 10 tie it, 11 and 12 untie it.

name: thinker
subject: A person sits on a low block in profile and leans forward into the thinker pose, elbow on the knee, chin on the fist. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: run
subject: A person in outline only, never filled, runs toward the right in profile, leaning forward, on one baseline. One run cycle; legs and arms clearly alternate.

name: door-open
subject: Fixed camera. A tall plain door from the floor to above the head; a whole person in profile beside it holds the knob. The door swings open. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: camera-flash
subject: A person in profile holds a camera to the eye, nobody else. A coral watercolor flash bursts in front of the camera, grows, then fades away. Coral only on the flash.

name: sofa-typing
subject: Close-up of two hands in outline typing on a laptop resting on knees. Same framing; fingers rise and press keys in turn, one smooth typing loop.

name: accordion
subject: A standing person in profile plays an accordion. The bellows open from closed to wide, then close again; the head tilts with them.

name: yoga
subject: A person in outline only, never filled, on a mat. Arms rise from palms together to high above the head while one foot lifts into tree pose. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: suitcase-run
subject: A person in outline only runs toward the right pulling a rolling suitcase, one baseline. One run cycle; legs clearly alternate, the suitcase bounces.

name: envelope-open
subject: Two hands in outline only hold an envelope, nobody else. The flap lifts and a letter marked with a big @ slides out. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: checklist-tick
subject: A sheet with three wavy lines and boxes, a hand with a pen draws one tick in the first box, stroke by stroke, then the pen lifts. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: snow-globe
subject: Only a snow globe on a simple base with a small mountain inside, no person. Snowflake dots fall slowly, a little lower each panel, a smooth loop.

name: card-pay
subject: A hand holds a bank card and lowers it onto a small loose payment terminal; dots then a check mark appear on its screen; the card rises again. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: coffee-sip
subject: A person in profile at a desk with a laptop, a cup beside. The hand leaves the keyboard, lifts the cup to the mouth, sips. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: fever
subject: A tired person in profile holds a phone to the ear; a big loose thermometer beside, coral watercolor inside rising to the top while the head droops. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.

name: binoculars
subject: A person in profile holds binoculars in both hands in every panel. They lower the binoculars from the eyes to the chest, blink, and raise them back. Panels 1 to 7 go forward, panels 8 to 12 come back to panel 1.
